question: Who among the following cricketers is the brand ambassador of Jindal South West (JSW) Steel as of January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rishabh Pant**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rishabh Pant:**

 
 
• **Jindal South West (JSW) Steel has appointed Indian cricketer Rishabh Pant as its brand ambassador. Hence, Option 4 is correct.**
 
• Pant will help promote JSW’s steel products which include Colouron+ colour-coated sheets and JSW Neosteel TMT bars, for a three-year period.
 
• He is an Indian cricketer who plays as a middle-order wicket-keeper batsman for India, Delhi, and the Delhi Capitals in the Indian Premier League.
 
• He was the vice-captain of the India U-19 team for the 2016 Under-19 Cricket World Cup.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **JSW Steel Ltd:**

 
 
• **It is an Indian multinational steel-making company based in Mumbai, Maharashtra.**
 
• It is a subsidiary of **JSW Group.**
 
• It is one of the fastest-growing companies in India with a **global footprint in over 140 countries. **
